name: runtime-corrector
description: Evidence-bound native review; host execution, output and approvals remain native.

mode.description: RC 后台审批：普通模式在所属聊天中确认；无人值守只自动授权本次 RC 的专用工具。

noopToolCallGuard.description: Reject confirmed unchanged local write/edit/apply_patch requests before execution in enabled RC sessions on OpenClaw 2026.7.1-2, whose native no-op result terminates a tool batch. The rejection instructs the business model to continue. Set false to retain native no-op handling.

reviewerModel.description: Configured OpenClaw provider/model for reviewers; defaults to the active model.

stopReviewEngine.description: Stop always uses task workers. The deprecated native value is accepted for compatibility and normalized to task.

reviewerTimeoutMs.description: Optional explicit reviewer cap; otherwise project reviewer timeout applies. Does not increase host Hook or parent task budgets.

businessRunTimeoutMs.description: Optional RC business-correction execution window, separate from reviewer and Hook budgets. Zero disables the RC execution deadline after a trusted start; admission, reviews, cancellation and scope checks remain active. The host run timeout is configured separately.

baselineWireMode.description: Optional existing baseline extraction encoding. All modes retain complete original reads, source binding and independent coverage audit.

baselineLimits.description: Finite baseline-only time, shared extractor/auditor model steps, repair and audit limits. Every limit remains bound to the original persistent journal.

hookTimeoutMs.description: Independent RC review and reply-wait budget. Hot lifecycle hooks are capped at 10 seconds; native model review runs outside those hooks.

stopReviewConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent post-run Stop reviews shared fairly by Sessions. Queue time is included in each review window.

agentConcurrency.description: Optional Gateway-wide limit for concurrent RC private Agent runs, including requirement-frame workers, baseline extraction, and Stop reviewers. Queued runs keep their original deadlines.

finalizeReviewWaitMs.description: assessment-only short opportunity for same-run Stop revision. Ignored by until_pass, which always starts correction in a new run after the host finishes.
